title: Intrinsic Geometry Matching: learning observation-equivariant process geometry
title_zh: 内蕴几何匹配（Intrinsic Geometry Matching, IGM）

paragraphs.en: Real data are often arbitrary, indirect observations of an unknown underlying process, and those observations can distort its geometry. Existing geometric methods equip data with the induced geometry of the ambient space, but this entangles the true geometry of the process with the distortion of the observation. To address this, we introduce Intrinsic Geometry Matching (IGM) : a scalable approach to learn the intrinsic geometry of the underlying process. Specifically, we learn the carré du champ operator of the process, allowing us to recover its diffusion geometry. Our method uses the fact that data often come with natural perturbations, like steps in a time series, to recover the intrinsic carré du champ while transforming naturally with changes in observation: it is observation-equivariant . Furthermore, since this equivariance relates the geometry of different spaces, we can train a model using additional sources of data, even when that data lies in another space. We evaluate IGM on molecular dynamics, image, and video data and find better performance and scaling than existing neural and graph-based geometric tools.
paragraphs.zh: 真实数据通常是对未知底层过程的任意、间接观察，而这些观察可能会扭曲其几何结构。 现有的几何方法为数据赋予了环境空间的诱导几何，但这会将过程的真实几何与观察带来的扭曲纠缠在一起。 为解决这一问题，我们提出了内在几何匹配（IGM）：一种可扩展的方法，用于学习底层过程的内在几何。 具体来说，我们学习该过程的“场平方”算子，从而能够恢复其扩散几何结构。 我们的方法利用了数据通常带有自然扰动（如时间序列中的步长）这一特性，在随观察变化自然转换的同时恢复内在的“场平方”算子：它具有观察等价性。 此外，由于这种等价性关联了不同空间的几何结构，我们甚至可以利用其他空间的数据源来训练模型。 我们在分子动力学、图像和视频数据上对 IGM 进行了评估，发现其性能和可扩展性优于现有的神经和图基几何工具。

paragraphs.en: Real data are often arbitrary, indirect observations of an unknown underlying process. In biology, cells, tissues, genomes, and proteins evolve and adapt, but can only be observed through noisy and often destructive experiments. Climate and weather systems have complex, chaotic structure, which is only partially captured by a sparse network of sensors and satellites. These processes are governed by physical laws and constraints, so the data we collect have geometry . This geometry can tell us about the structure of the underlying system, but the geometry we observe is distorted by the nature of the observation. For example, the distance between two satellite images as vectors is not the same as the physical ‘distance’ between the weather systems they observe. As the frontier of scientific AI moves from representing states to representing processes, the corresponding geometric challenge is to disentangle the true process geometry from the arbitrary observation geometry .
paragraphs.zh: 真实数据通常是对未知底层过程的任意、间接的观察。 在生物学中，细胞、组织、基因组和蛋白质会演化与适应，但只能通过充满噪声且常常具有破坏性的实验进行观察。 气候和天气系统具有复杂而混沌的结构，而这种结构仅能通过稀疏的传感器和卫星网络部分捕捉到。 这些过程受物理定律和约束的支配，因此我们收集的数据具有几何特性。 这种几何特性可以揭示底层系统的结构，但我们观察到的几何特性会因观察方式本身而失真。 例如，两个卫星图像作为向量之间的距离，并不等同于它们所观测的天气系统之间的物理“距离”。 随着科学人工智能的研究前沿从状态表示转向过程表示，相应的几何挑战便在于如何从任意的观察几何中分离出真实的进程几何。

sents.en: As the frontier of scientific AI moves from representing states to representing processes, the corresponding geometric challenge is to disentangle the true process geometry from the arbitrary observation geometry .
sents.zh: 随着科学人工智能的研究前沿从状态表示转向过程表示，相应的几何挑战便在于如何从任意的观察几何中分离出真实的进程几何。

paragraphs.en: Scientific modelling is fundamentally concerned with systems under change: trajectories, perturbations, constraints, interventions, and controls. The mathematical language of change is calculus , which works with notions of derivative. On nonlinear manifolds, this is generalised by Riemannian geometry , whose basic primitive is the Riemannian metric. This picture provides a useful geometric intuition for machine learning as the Manifold Hypothesis , which posits that high-dimensional data actually lie on a low-dimensional manifold ( Tenenbaum et al., 2000 ; Roweis and Saul, 2000 ; Bengio et al., 2012 ) . In reality, it is mostly just a metaphor: many complex scientific systems exhibit varying dimensionality, branches, singularities and discrete–continuous structure, so a smooth manifold of fixed dimension is too rigid an operational model.
paragraphs.zh: 科学建模本质上关注的是处于变化中的系统：轨迹、扰动、约束、干预和控制。 描述变化的数学语言是微积分，它基于导数的概念进行运算。 在非线性流形上，这一理论通过黎曼几何得到推广，其基本原始要素是黎曼度量。 这一框架为机器学习提供了有益的几何直觉，即流形假设：该假设认为高维数据实际上位于一个低维流形之上（Tenenbaum et al., 2000；Roweis and Saul, 2000；Bengio et al., 2012）。 实际上，这大多只是一种隐喻：许多复杂的科学系统表现出不同的维度、分支、奇点以及离散-连续结构，因此一个固定维度的光滑流形作为操作模型显得过于僵化。

sents.en: Scientific modelling is fundamentally concerned with systems under change: trajectories, perturbations, constraints, interventions, and controls.
sents.zh: 科学建模本质上关注的是处于变化中的系统：轨迹、扰动、约束、干预和控制。

sents.zh: 在非线性流形上，这一理论通过黎曼几何得到推广，其基本原始要素是黎曼度量。

sents.en: This picture provides a useful geometric intuition for machine learning as the Manifold Hypothesis , which posits that high-dimensional data actually lie on a low-dimensional manifold ( Tenenbaum et al., 2000 ; Roweis and Saul, 2000 ; Bengio et al., 2012 ) .

sents.en: In reality, it is mostly just a metaphor: many complex scientific systems exhibit varying dimensionality, branches, singularities and discrete–continuous structure, so a smooth manifold of fixed dimension is too rigid an operational model.
sents.zh: 实际上，这大多只是一种隐喻：许多复杂的科学系统表现出不同的维度、分支、奇点以及离散-连续结构，因此一个固定维度的光滑流形作为操作模型显得过于僵化。

paragraphs.en: To properly model this heterogeneous structure, we need a geometric theory that is both more flexible and computable from data. These requirements point to diffusion geometry ( Jones, 2024 ; Bakry et al., 2013 ) , which extends Riemannian constructions to irregular manifold-like structures via the calculus of Markov diffusion operators. Since it is defined in terms of a process, it provides a natural model for the process geometry underlying observed data. Its metric-like analogue is the carré du champ (CDC) operator ( Bakry and Émery, 1985 ; Kunita, 1969 ) , which measures the local directions of variability within the space, and can be used to recover its calculus and geometry. Crucially, the CDC transforms naturally under observation: when an underlying, latent process is observed by a map into ℝ D \mathbb{R}^{D} , the CDC pushes forward to ℝ D \mathbb{R}^{D} by conjugation with the derivative of the map. We call this relationship observation equivariance : the geometry is still intrinsic, and the observation map can be exchanged for another in a predictable way ( fig. 1 , right). If we could find a way to learn this natural CDC from data, we would have successfully disentangled the process geometry from the observation geometry via a clean algebraic factorisation.
paragraphs.zh: 为了正确建模这种异质结构，我们需要一种既更具灵活性又能从数据中计算得出的几何理论。 这些要求指向了扩散几何（Jones, 2024；Bakry 等人，2013），它通过马尔可夫扩散算子的微积分，将黎曼构造扩展到不规则的流形类结构。 由于它是基于一个过程定义的，因此为观测数据背后的过程几何提供了一个自然的模型。 其类度量的对应物是 carré du champ（CDC）算子（Bakry 和 Émery，1985；Kunita，1969），它衡量空间内的局部变化方向，并可用于恢复其微积分和几何结构。 关键在于，CDC 在观测下具有自然的变换性：当一个潜在的底层过程通过一个映射到 ℝ D \mathbb{R}^{D} 的映射被观测时，CDC 会通过与该映射导数共轭的方式前推至 ℝ D \mathbb{R}^{D}。 我们将这种关系称为观测等变性：几何结构仍然是内在的，并且观测映射可以以一种可预测的方式被另一个映射所替代（图 1，右侧）。 如果我们能找到一种从数据中学习这种自然 CDC 的方法，我们就成功通过干净的代数分解，将过程几何与观测几何分离开来。

paragraphs.en: Standard geometric methods treat the data as an unordered point cloud with no additional structure, and equip it with the geometry of the ambient space it is observed in ( Lebanon, 2012 ; Hauberg et al., 2012 ; Jones and Lanners, 2026 ) . On a manifold, this means using the induced ambient Riemannian metric, so geometric measurements, like geodesic distances, are observation-dependent ( fig. 1 , left).
paragraphs.zh: 标准的几何方法将数据视为一个没有额外结构的无序点云，并赋予其观测所在环境空间的几何特性（Lebanon, 2012；Hauberg 等, 2012；Jones 和 Lanners, 2026）。 在流形上，这意味着使用诱导的环境黎曼度量，因此测地距离等几何测量依赖于观测方式（图 1，左侧）。

sents.en: Standard geometric methods treat the data as an unordered point cloud with no additional structure, and equip it with the geometry of the ambient space it is observed in ( Lebanon, 2012 ; Hauberg et al., 2012 ; Jones and Lanners, 2026 ) .

paragraphs.en: While this problem can be partially addressed with graph-based methods when the Jacobian of the observation map is known or can be estimated from dense local samples ( Singer and Coifman, 2008 ; Singer et al., 2009 ; Talmon and Coifman, 2013 ) , this information is rare in practice. Graph methods also suffer from drawbacks like poor scalability and generalisation, and the curse of dimensionality, which can be overcome with deep learning.
paragraphs.zh: 尽管当观测映射的雅可比矩阵已知或能够从密集局部样本中估计时，基于图的方法可以在一定程度上解决这一问题（Singer 和 Coifman，2008；Singer 等，2009；Talmon 和 Coifman，2013），但这类信息在实践中却十分罕见。 图方法还存在可扩展性和泛化能力差以及维度诅咒等缺点，而深度学习可以克服这些问题。

sents.en: Graph methods also suffer from drawbacks like poor scalability and generalisation, and the curse of dimensionality, which can be overcome with deep learning.
sents.zh: 图方法还存在可扩展性和泛化能力差以及维度诅咒等缺点，而深度学习可以克服这些问题。

paragraphs.en: Our approach overcomes these challenges by exploiting the fact that many real data sets have additional semantic structure in the form of natural perturbations or augmentations , which define their diffusion geometry. For example, the steps in a time series represent a genuine sample from the underlying process . We show that the true CDC, and hence the true geometry, can be inferred from these perturbations, and provide a scalable algorithm for training a neural network to learn it.
paragraphs.zh: 我们的方法利用了这样一个事实：许多真实数据集以自然扰动或增强的形式具有额外的语义结构，这些结构定义了它们的扩散几何。 例如，时间序列中的各个步骤代表了底层过程的一个真实样本。 我们证明了真正的 CDC（以及由此决定的真正几何）可以从这些扰动中推断出来，并提供了一种可扩展的算法来训练神经网络以学习它。

sents.en: Our approach overcomes these challenges by exploiting the fact that many real data sets have additional semantic structure in the form of natural perturbations or augmentations , which define their diffusion geometry.
sents.zh: 我们的方法利用了这样一个事实：许多真实数据集以自然扰动或增强的形式具有额外的语义结构，这些结构定义了它们的扩散几何。

sents.en: For example, the steps in a time series represent a genuine sample from the underlying process .
sents.zh: 例如，时间序列中的各个步骤代表了底层过程的一个真实样本。

sents.en: We show that the true CDC, and hence the true geometry, can be inferred from these perturbations, and provide a scalable algorithm for training a neural network to learn it.
sents.zh: 我们证明了真正的 CDC（以及由此决定的真正几何）可以从这些扰动中推断出来，并提供了一种可扩展的算法来训练神经网络以学习它。

paragraphs.en: When data come from an unknown, latent stochastic process, we describe the intrinsic geometry in terms of the carré du champ operator (CDC). This CDC is intrinsic to the process and observation-equivariant .
paragraphs.zh: 当数据来自一个未知且潜在的随机过程时，我们通过 carré du champ 算子（CDC）来描述其内在几何结构。 这种 CDC 是该过程的内在属性，并且具有观测不变性。

sents.en: When data come from an unknown, latent stochastic process, we describe the intrinsic geometry in terms of the carré du champ operator (CDC).
sents.zh: 当数据来自一个未知且潜在的随机过程时，我们通过 carré du champ 算子（CDC）来描述其内在几何结构。

sents.en: This CDC is intrinsic to the process and observation-equivariant .
sents.zh: 这种 CDC 是该过程的内在属性，并且具有观测不变性。

paragraphs.en: We present Intrinsic Geometry Matching (IGM) : a scalable loss for learning the intrinsic CDC from data perturbations, and show that it is the unique observation-invariant loss.
paragraphs.zh: 我们提出了内在几何匹配（Intrinsic Geometry Matching，简称 IGM）：一种可扩展的损失函数，用于从数据扰动中学习内在 CDC，并证明了它是唯一具有观测不变性的损失函数。

paragraphs.en: We exploit observation equivariance to train IGM from data in different spaces.
paragraphs.zh: 我们利用观察等变性，从不同空间的数据中训练 IGM。

paragraphs.en: We evaluate IGM on a range of high-dimensional datasets, demonstrating better performance, scaling properties, and training stability than existing methods.
paragraphs.zh: 我们在一系列高维数据集上对 IGM 进行了评估，结果表明其性能、扩展性和训练稳定性均优于现有方法。

paragraphs.en: Diffusion geometry extends Riemannian geometry to non-manifolds using the Bakry–Émery theory of Markov diffusion operators ( Jones, 2024 ; Bakry and Émery, 1985 ) . On a manifold ℳ \mathcal{M} , the geometry and calculus are captured by the metric, which satisfies 2 ​ g ​ ( ∇ f , ∇ h ) = Δ ⁡ ( f ​ h ) − f ​ Δ ​ h − h ​ Δ ​ f 2g(\nabla f,\nabla h)=\Delta(fh)-f\Delta h-h\Delta f , where Δ \Delta is the Laplace-Beltrami operator. paragraphs.en: The methods we discuss here all use a notion of local kernel or perturbation, which can be unified in the language of Markov processes . Let μ \mu be a probability measure on a state space 𝒳 \mathcal{X} , and let P + ​ ( x , d ​ y ) P^{+}(x,\mathrm{d}y) be a Markov kernel : a probability measure for perturbations y y of a sample x x . We call P + P^{+} the forward process . If X ∼ μ X\sim\mu and Y ∼ P + ​ ( X , ⋅ ) Y\sim P^{+}(X,\cdot) , this defines a joint distribution π ⁡ ( d ​ x , d ​ y ) \pi(\mathrm{d}x,\mathrm{d}y) and marginal ν ⁡ ( d ​ y ) \nu(\mathrm{d}y) for Y Y . Together, these define the backward process P − ​ ( y , d ​ x ) P^{-}(y,\mathrm{d}x) by μ ⁡ ( d ​ x ) ​ P + ​ ( x , d ​ y ) = π ⁡ ( d ​ x , d ​ y ) = ν ⁡ ( d ​ y ) ​ P − ​ ( y , d ​ x ) , \mu(\mathrm{d}x)\,P^{+}(x,\mathrm{d}y)=\pi(\mathrm{d}x,\mathrm{d}y)=\nu(\mathrm{d}y)\,P^{-}(y,\mathrm{d}x), which represents the conditional distribution of X X given Y = y Y=y , so P − P^{-} is the μ \mu -dependent posterior given the prior P + P^{+} .

However, these kernel-based approaches have all the drawbacks of kernel machine learning: poor scalability, the curse of dimensionality, and poor generalisation. This has motivated a range of new geometric methods based on deep learning . Neural networks can be trained to estimate kernel-based expressions by recognising that kernel functions, like the Gaussian, are likelihood functions , whose closed-form expressions can be replaced by Monte Carlo averages over samples. By finding an appropriate sample-wise loss, we can estimate the same objects without ever evaluating the kernel.

paragraphs.en: This idea is central to diffusion models, where score matching ( Song et al., 2020 ; Song and Ermon, 2019 ) is a kernel-free estimate of Laplacian eigenmaps . In this special case of Gaussian noise, we can recover the geometry for free, since the covariance-based CDC formula above is just the Jacobian of the score matching denoiser ( Manor and Michaeli, 2024 ; Kharitenko et al., 2026 ) , and is also related to the second-order score ( Meng et al., 2021 ) . The first method to learn the CDC in full generality was Riemannian metric matching (RMM) ( Bamberger et al., 2026a ) , which can target either of the CDC estimates above, and exploits a low-rank parametrisation to allow scaling to high-dimensional spaces.
paragraphs.zh: 这一思想是扩散模型的核心，其中分数匹配（Song 等人，2020；Song 和 Ermon，2019）是对拉普拉斯特征图的一种无核估计。 在噪声为高斯分布的这一特殊情况下，我们可以免费恢复几何结构，因为上述基于协方差的 CDC 公式实际上就是分数匹配去噪器的雅可比矩阵（Manor 和 Michaeli，2024；Kharitenko 等人，2026），并且也与二阶分数相关（Meng 等人，2021）。 第一种在完全通用情况下学习 CDC 的方法是黎曼度量匹配（RMM）（Bamberger 等人，2026a），它可以针对上述任意一种 CDC 估计量，并利用低秩参数化实现向高维空间的扩展。

paragraphs.en: Geometric methods involve a kernel or prior, and make estimates involving the posterior. We ask: if the prior is more naturally adapted to the data, is the learned geometry more meaningful? In the extreme: if the prior is genuinely intrinsic , like sampling steps in a time series, can we learn the true intrinsic geometry? We now define what ‘intrinsic geometry’ means for data.

paragraphs.en: We have defined the BMM and CBMM losses as estimators for the forward process CDC G τ G_{\tau} , which is natural when P τ P^{\tau} gives samples from an underlying Markov process. However, most methods for computational geometry and generative modelling use an uninformative forward kernel P τ P^{\tau} (e.g. Gaussian), and the posterior P − τ P^{-\tau} models the structure. We can learn the backward CDC G − τ G_{-\tau} by simply replacing X ∼ μ X\sim\mu with Y ∼ ν Y\sim\nu ( section 2.2 ) in L BMM L_{\mathrm{BMM}} , and G τ ​ ( X ) G_{\tau}(X) with G τ ​ ( Y ) G_{\tau}(Y) in L CBMM L_{\mathrm{CBMM}} . In this case we recover the RMM loss of Bamberger et al. (2026a) when Y | X = x ∼ 𝒩 ⁡ ( x , τ ​ I ) Y\mid X=x\sim\mathcal{N}(x,\tau I) and 𝒟 ⁡ ( ⋅ , ⋅ ) \mathcal{D}(\cdot,\cdot) is Frobenius.
paragraphs.zh: 我们将 BMM 和 CBMM 损失定义为前向过程 CDC G τ G_{\tau} 的估计量，当 P τ P^{\tau} 提供来自潜在马尔可夫过程的样本时，这种定义是合理的。然而，计算几何和生成建模中的大多数方法都使用一个无信息的前向核 P τ P^{\tau}（例如高斯核），而后验 P − τ P^{-\tau} 则用于建模结构。通过在 L BMM L_{\mathrm{BMM}} 中简单地将 X ∼ μ X\sim\mu 替换为 Y ∼ ν Y\sim\nu（第 2.2 节），以及在 L CBMM L_{\mathrm{CBMM}} 中将 G τ ​ ( X ) G_{\tau}(X) 替换为 G τ ​ ( Y ) G_{\tau}(Y)，我们即可学习后向过程 CDC G − τ G_{-\tau}。在这种情况下，当 Y | X = x ∼ 𝒩 ⁡ ( x , τ ​ I ) Y\mid X=x\sim\mathcal{N}(x,\tau I) 且 𝒟 ⁡ ( ⋅ , ⋅ ) \mathcal{D}(\cdot,\cdot) 为弗罗贝尼乌斯范数时，我们便得到了 Bamberger 等人（2026a）提出的 RMM 损失。

paragraphs.en: The proofs are in App. A . These results show that LogDet is the only observation-invariant loss that permits sample-wise training . paragraphs.en: Observation equivariance explicitly relates the geometry of different spaces. We can exploit this to train a model in one space with data from another, potentially unlocking opportunities for scaling data in applications. There are two settings for this, based on the information available.

paragraphs.en: We test four defining properties of IGM in a controlled setting with known process geometry and observation map: (i) recovering the true process geometry under non-isometric observation; (ii) the advantage of LogDet over Frobenius loss; (iii) scaling laws, in terms of intrinsic and observation dimensions; and (iv) recovering intrinsic geometry from an ensemble of partial, rank-deficient views.
paragraphs.zh: 我们在一个具有已知过程几何结构和观测映射的受控环境中，测试了 IGM 的四个核心特性：(i) 在非等距观测条件下恢复真实的过程几何结构；(ii) LogDet 相较于 Frobenius 损失的优势；(iii) 内在维度和观测维度方面的缩放定律；以及 (iv) 从一组部分且秩不足的视角中恢复内在几何结构。

paragraphs.en: We simulate a latent process as Brownian motion on the flat torus 𝕋 d \mathbb{T}^{d} , with cometric I d I_{d} , observed through a curved, non-isometric embedding into ℝ D \mathbb{R}^{D} ( fig. 3 (a) ). We train different CDCs on ℝ D \mathbb{R}^{D} with different methods: IGM uses the pushforward method with the known differential ( section 4.3 ), FGM (Frobenius geometry matching) denotes the same method but with Frobenius regression not LogDet, and LD-RMM (LogDet Riemannian metric matching) uses ambient Gaussian perturbations with LogDet 2 2 2 LogDet-RMM modifies the RMM of Bamberger et al. (2026a) by changing the loss from Frobenius to LogDet and jointly training a mean and covariance model (which is not possible with Frobenius). . Finally, k k NN estimates a centred, kernel-weighted covariance of clean observations ( Jones and Lanners, 2026 ) . Further details are in App. D.1 .
paragraphs.zh: 我们将一个潜在过程模拟为平坦环面 𝕋 d \mathbb{T}^{d} 上的布朗运动，其伴随度量为 I d I_{d}，并通过一种弯曲的非等距嵌入到 ℝ D \mathbb{R}^{D} 中加以观测（图 3(a)）。 我们在 ℝ D \mathbb{R}^{D} 上使用不同方法训练不同的 CDC：IGM 使用已知的微分量的前推法（第 4.3 节），FGM（Frobenius 几何匹配）表示相同的方法，但采用 Frobenius 回归而非 LogDet；而 LD-RMM（LogDet 黎曼度量匹配）则使用环境高斯扰动与 LogDet。LogDet-RMM 修改了 Bamberger 等人（2026a）提出的 RMM，具体方法是将损失函数从 Frobenius 改为 LogDet，并联合训练均值和协方差模型（这在 Frobenius 框架下无法实现）。 （2026a） 最后，k k NN 估计出干净观测数据的中心化、核加权协方差（Jones 和 Lanners, 2026）。 更多细节见附录 D.1。

paragraphs.en: We compute geodesics in latent coordinates for each CDC by minimising the path energy ( fig. 3 (a) ). IGM recovers the true, straight line geodesics (the shortest paths for the process), whereas LD-RMM finds the shortest paths in observation space.

paragraphs.en: When natural process transitions are unavailable, we can simulate them with data augmentation . This encompasses Gaussian noise models, where the prior contains no geometric information, so we now investigate whether semantically meaningful augmentations Y ∼ P τ ​ ( X , ⋅ ) Y\sim P^{\tau}(X,\cdot) induce a better geometry. We test whether (i) IGM on principled augmentations has better downstream performance than LD-RMM, (ii) this process geometry transfers across data distributions without retraining. We set P τ P^{\tau} to be a smooth spatial deformation in the plane, known as metamorphosis ( Holm et al., 2008 ; Younes, 2010 ; François et al., 2021 ) . IGM learns the uncentred forward field G τ G_{\tau} from these transitions, whereas LD-RMM learns a mean-centred backward field from isotropic Gaussian perturbations. Both covariance estimators use the same U-Net backbone and rank- 100 100 factorization with a learned isotropic floor. Full details are in App. D.2 .

paragraphs.en: We can visualise the learned CDC geometry from its leading eigenvectors, which generate the tangent space at each point. These learned vectors are highly interpretable, and describe increasingly complex deformations. We apply the CDC to compute interpolating paths between images using Riemannian optimisation , taking gradient-descent steps from a source image x 0 x_{0} down the target potential 1 2 ​ ‖ x − x 1 ‖ 2 2 \tfrac{1}{2}\|x-x_{1}\|_{2}^{2} . This is a challenging problem in pixel space, and existing approaches typically use a per-step denoiser to improve path quality ( Kharitenko et al., 2026 ; Kawasaki-Borruat et al., 2026 ) . We evaluate without these tricks, and find that IGM is sufficient for smooth, semantic transformations fig. 5 (c) while LD-RMM produces irregular paths with pixel-level artifacts fig. 5 (b) .
paragraphs.zh: 我们可以通过其主特征向量来可视化学习到的 CDC 几何结构，这些特征向量生成了每个点的切空间。 这些学习到的向量具有高度的可解释性，并且描述了越来越复杂的形变。 我们应用 CDC 结合黎曼优化来计算图像之间的插值路径，即从源图像 x₀（x_{0}）出发，沿着目标势函数 \tfrac{1}{2}\|x-x_{1}\|_{2}^{2} 进行梯度下降步骤。 这是像素空间中的一个具有挑战性的问题，现有方法通常会在每一步使用去噪器来提高路径质量（Kharitenko 等人，2026；Kawasaki-Borruat 等人，2026）。 我们在不使用这些技巧的情况下进行了评估，发现 IGM 足以实现平滑的语义变换（图 5(c)），而 LD-RMM 则会产生带有像素级伪影的不规则路径（图 5(b)）。

paragraphs.en: We perform the same evaluations on out-of-distribution EMNIST letters without fine-tuning. The LD-RMM interpolating paths lose quality on this unseen data, while IGM has no visible degradation and retains meaningful tangent vectors. This suggests that IGM geometry is portable , and can robustly generalise beyond the training distribution.
paragraphs.zh: 我们在未分布的 EMNIST 字母数据集上执行相同的评估，且无需微调。 LD-RMM 的插值路径在这些未见过的数据上质量下降，而 IGM 则没有明显的性能退化，并保留了有意义的切向量。 这表明 IGM 几何结构具有可移植性，并且能够稳健地泛化到训练分布之外的数据。

paragraphs.en: We do have access to natural image perturbations from video, where the jumps between time steps represent an intrinsic sample from an underlying process. We train IGM with a low-rank UNet backbone on 64 × 64 64\times 64 videos from CelebV-HQ ( Zhu et al., 2022 ) , and compare with LD-RMM. We test whether (i) IGM with natural perturbations recovers the intrinsic process geometry, (ii) how efficiently IGM and LD-RMM learn the tangent spaces of the data. Full details are in App. D.3 , and we visualise the learned tangent vectors in fig. 14 and fig. 15 .
paragraphs.zh: 我们确实可以从视频中获取自然图像扰动，其中时间步之间的跳跃代表了一个潜在过程的内在样本。我们在 CelebV-HQ（Zhu et al., 2022）的 64 × 64 视频上，使用低秩 UNet 主干网络训练 IGM，并与 LD-RMM 进行比较。我们检验了以下两点：(i) 使用自然扰动的 IGM 是否能够恢复内在过程的几何结构；(ii) IGM 和 LD-RMM 学习数据切线空间的效率如何。完整细节见附录 D.3，我们在图 14 和图 15 中展示了学习到的切向量。

paragraphs.en: We can measure intrinsic geometry recovery by interpreting the learned CDC as a Gaussian model and evaluating the negative log-likelihood (NLL) of held-out test transition pairs ( fig. 6 (a) ). Since IGM is trained directly on the process, it recovers the true geometry substantially more accurately at each rank.
paragraphs.zh: 我们可以通过将学习到的 CDC 解释为高斯模型，并评估保留的测试转换对的负对数似然（NLL），来衡量内在几何结构的恢复情况（图 6 (a)）。 由于 IGM 是直接在过程上进行训练的，因此它在每个秩上都能更准确地恢复真实的几何结构。

paragraphs.en: As in the synthetic experiments, we can compare different CDCs by their tangent space recovery . For a rank- r r model, at each dimension k ≤ r k\leq r , we can compute the explained variance of the first k k eigenvectors. For test transition pairs ( x t , x t + τ ) (x_{t},x_{t+\tau}) , we can measure the fraction of the variance of x t + τ − x t x_{t+\tau}-x_{t} retained after projection into the first k k CDC principal components, and plot the profile over k k in ( fig. 6 (b) ). IGM recovers the true tangent spaces in far fewer dimensions than LD-RMM. We visualise the learned tangent vectors in fig. 7 (see also fig. 14 and fig. 15 ).

paragraphs.en: Representation learning is usually focused on achieving a target latent distribution, but this is not always a good proxy for the geometry of the underlying process ( Arvanitidis et al., 2017 ) . IGM addresses this mismatch by learning the correct intrinsic geometry in the latent space. Using molecular dynamics in a frozen SLAE representation ( Chen et al., 2025 ) , we test whether (i) IGM recovers the process geometry in latent coordinates, (ii) this geometry improves held-out transition paths, and (iii) observation equivariance transports this geometry to physically meaningful molecular motion.
paragraphs.zh: 表示学习通常专注于实现目标潜在分布，但这并不总能很好地反映底层过程的几何结构（Arvanitidis 等人，2017）。 IGM 通过在潜在空间中学习正确的内在几何结构来解决这种不匹配问题。 在冻结的 SLAE 表示中使用分子动力学（Chen 等人，2025），我们检验了以下三点：(i) IGM 是否在潜在坐标中恢复了过程几何结构；(ii) 这种几何结构是否改进了保留的转移路径；以及 (iii) 观测等变性能否将这种几何结构转化为具有物理意义的分子运动。

paragraphs.en: We use 200 200 dynamic importance sampling trajectories of adenylate kinase ( Perilla et al., 2011 ; Beckstein et al., 2009 ) and a frozen SLAE encoder Φ \Phi ( Chen et al., 2025 ) which maps each molecular structure X t X_{t} to 214 214 residue-wise embeddings with 128 128 channels, so Y t = Φ ⁡ ( X t ) ∈ ℝ 214 × 128 Y_{t}=\Phi(X_{t})\in\mathbb{R}^{214\times 128} . Following section 4.3 , we apply IGM directly to the encoded transitions ( Y t , Y t + τ ) (Y_{t},Y_{t+\tau}) , learning the conditional mean m τ ϕ m_{\tau}^{\phi} and centred forward field G τ θ G_{\tau}^{\theta} . Full details are in App. D.4 .

paragraphs.en: As in section 5.3 , we measure intrinsic geometry recovery with NLL and explained variance of the CDC on test trajectories ( fig. 9 (a) ). NLL decreases consistently with rank and surpasses the best isotropic baseline, while increasing rank from 16 16 to 512 512 raises explained residual variance to 72.2 % 72.2\% . Together, these results reveal substantial anisotropic structure in the molecular transition process.
paragraphs.zh: 与第 5.3 节一样，我们通过 NLL 和测试轨迹上 CDC 的解释方差来衡量内在几何结构的恢复情况（图 9(a)）。 NLL 随着秩的增加而持续下降，并超过了最佳各向同性基线；而当秩从 16×16 增加到 512×512 时，解释的残差方差则上升至 72.2%。 综合来看，这些结果揭示了分子过渡过程中存在显著的各向异性结构。

paragraphs.en: We test whether the learned geometry improves transition paths between observed molecular states ( Diepeveen et al., 2024 ) . We construct an IGM bridge by conditioning the learned transition model on the observed endpoints, using its conditional mean and CDC along the predicted path (App. D.4 ). Its conditional mean defines the IGM bridge. Figure 9 shows one such transition in latent PCA (b) and as decoded structures (c , top ) . We compare each decoded path with the corresponding held-out MD trajectory using discrete Fréchet distance with C α \alpha Kabsch-RMSD as ground distance ( Seyler et al., 2015 ) . IGM improves on latent linear interpolation for all 20 20 test trajectories, by 30.1 % 30.1\% on average.
paragraphs.zh: 我们检验所学到的几何结构是否改进了已观测分子状态之间的转换路径（Diepeveen 等人，2024）。 我们通过将已学习的转换模型以已观测的端点为条件，利用其条件均值和沿预测路径的 CDC，构建一个 IGM 桥接（附录 D.4）。 其条件均值定义了 IGM 桥接。 图 9 展示了这样一个转换过程在潜在 PCA 空间中的表现（b），以及解码后的结构（c，顶部）。 我们使用离散 Fréchet 距离，并以 Cα Kabsch-RMSD 作为基准距离，将每条解码路径与对应的保留 MD 轨迹进行比较（Seyler 等人，2015）。 IGM 在所有 20 条测试轨迹上均优于潜在线性插值，平均改进幅度为 30.1%。

paragraphs.en: We use observation equivariance to push forward the learned CDC through the frozen SLAE decoder Ψ \Psi and visualise molecular mobility as per-residue displacement ellipsoids ( fig. 9 (c , bottom ) ). The predicted mobility concentrates in the LID and NMP domains relative to the CORE , consistent with the known open–closed motion of AdK ( Beckstein et al., 2009 ) . Thus, the learned latent process geometry can be transported back to reveal physically meaningful molecular motion.
paragraphs.zh: 我们利用观察等变性将学习到的 CDC 通过冻结的 SLAE 解码器 Ψ \Psi 前推，并将分子运动性可视化为每个残基的位移椭球体（图 9 (c, 底部)）。 预测的运动性相对于 CORE 主要集中在 LID 和 NMP 结构域中，这与 AdK 已知的开合运动一致（Beckstein 等，2009）。 因此，可以将学习到的潜在过程几何结构反向传输，以揭示具有物理意义的分子运动。

paragraphs.en: We introduced Intrinsic Geometry Matching (IGM) : a scalable approach to learning the intrinsic geometry of data, thereby disentangling the underlying process geometry from the distortion of the observation. Our insight is that this geometry can be described with diffusion geometry through its carré du champ (CDC) operator, and the CDC can be learned from intrinsic perturbations of the data, even when embedded non-isometrically. This CDC is observation-equivariant , transforming naturally between different measurements, and we identify the LogDet divergence as the unique observation-invariant loss for learning it. We can exploit this equivariance to train a model in one space with data from another, potentially unlocking opportunities for scaling data in applications. In each case, it outperformed the Gaussian (observation-dependent) and graph-based estimators. We showed that IGM can induce geometry in latent spaces by learning the process geometry underlying molecular dynamics, recovering accurate trajectories and mobility fields.
paragraphs.zh: 我们提出了内在几何匹配（Intrinsic Geometry Matching，IGM）：一种可扩展的方法，用于学习数据的内在几何结构，从而将潜在的过程几何结构与观测中的失真分离开来。 我们的核心见解是，这种几何结构可以通过扩散几何及其 carré du champ（CDC）算子来描述，并且即使数据以非等距方式嵌入，也能通过数据的内在扰动学习到 CDC。 这种 CDC 具有观测等价性，能够自然地在不同测量之间转换，并且我们确定 LogDet 散度是学习它的唯一观测不变损失函数。 我们可以利用这种等价性，在一个空间中用来自另一个空间的数据训练模型，从而为数据扩展应用带来新的可能性。 在所有情况下，该方法的表现均优于高斯（依赖观测）估计器和基于图的估计器。 我们证明了 IGM 可以通过学习分子动力学背后的过程几何结构，在潜在空间中引入几何信息，并恢复出准确的轨迹和移动性场。

paragraphs.en: We prove that congruence invariance characterises the LogDet divergence, up to a positive scale, within the class of Bregman divergences considered in Proposition 4.3 . The argument first identifies the local Hessian form of a Bregman divergence and classifies congruence-invariant bilinear forms. Requiring such a form to be a Hessian then determines the LogDet generator up to affine terms. Naturality under nonlinear changes of observation follows pointwise from observation equivariance.
paragraphs.zh: 我们证明了，在命题 4.3 所考虑的布雷格曼散度类中，同构不变性（congruence invariance）能够刻画 LogDet 散度，最多相差一个正比例因子。 该论证首先确定布雷格曼散度的局部黑森矩阵形式，并对同构不变的二次型进行分类。 进一步要求这种形式为黑森矩阵，即可唯一确定 LogDet 生成函数，最多相差一些仿射项。 在非线性观测变换下的自然性（Naturality）可由观测等变性（observation equivariance）逐点推得。

paragraphs.en: IGM learns the uncentred forward field from metamorphic transitions, while LD-RMM learns a mean-centred backward field from isotropic Gaussian perturbations. Both CDC estimators use a scale-conditioned U-Net with base width 64 64 , channel multipliers ( 1 , 2 , 2 ) (1,2,2) , two residual blocks per resolution, and no dropout. Single-head self-attention is applied at downsampling factor 4 4 and in the middle block. A sinusoidal embedding of τ \tau , followed by a two-layer MLP, conditions each residual block. The CDC head outputs 100 100 spatial channels, flattened into U θ ∈ ℝ 100 × 784 U_{\theta}\in\mathbb{R}^{100\times 784} , and the cometric includes a learned isotropic floor. We use Adam with learning rate 2 × 10 − 4 2\times 10^{-4} , batch size 128 128 , no weight decay, and gradient clipping at norm 1 1 . After the fixed validation objective plateaus for 15 15 epochs, we trigger a 100 100 -epoch cosine decay of the learning rate to zero, with training capped at 200 200 epochs.
paragraphs.zh: IGM 通过形变转变学习无中心前向场，而 LD-RMM 则通过各向同性高斯扰动学习均值中心化后向场。 两种 CDC 估计器均使用基于尺度条件的 U-Net，其基础宽度为 64 64，通道乘数为 (1,2,2)，每个分辨率包含两个残差块，且未使用 dropout。 在采样下采样因子为 4 4 时以及在中间块中应用了单头自注意力机制。 对 τ \tau 的正弦嵌入后接一个双层 MLP，用于为每个残差块提供条件输入。 CDC 输出层产生 100 100 个空间通道，并将其展平为 U θ ∈ ℝ 100 × 784 U_{\theta}\in\mathbb{R}^{100\times 784}，同时共度量还包括一个可学习的各向同性基底。 我们使用 Adam 优化器，学习率为 2 × 10 − 4 2\times 10^{-4}，批量大小为 128 128，未使用权重衰减，并将梯度裁剪至范数 1 1。 在固定验证目标连续 15 15 个周期内不再下降后，我们将学习率以余弦函数形式在 100 100 个周期内衰减至零，且训练最多持续 200 200 个周期。

paragraphs.en: IGM is trained on forward pairs ( X , Y ) = ( x t , x t + τ ) (X,Y)=(x_{t},x_{t+\tau}) from a single clip, with τ ∈ [ 0.04 , 0.5 ] \tau\in[0.04,0.5] seconds. We pick a source frame uniformly among those with an eligible successor, sample a lag τ \tau log-uniformly in the range, and choose the successor closest in log-lag. We condition the network and normalise the loss with the actual timestamp difference in seconds, rather than the requested lag or a frame-index offset. In each training epoch, we sample just one pair per clip, so use a negligible fraction of the available training data even when training for over 1000 epochs.
paragraphs.zh: IGM 是在来自单个剪辑的前向配对 (X, Y) = (x_t, x_{t+\tau})（其中 τ ∈ [0.04, 0.5] 秒）上进行训练的。 我们从具有合格后续帧的帧中均匀选择一个源帧，在该范围内以对数均匀分布采样一个延迟 τ，并选择在对数延迟上最接近的后续帧。 我们以实际的时间戳差（单位：秒）来对网络进行条件约束和损失归一化，而不是使用请求的延迟或帧索引偏移量。 在每个训练周期中，我们每个剪辑仅采样一个配对，因此即使训练超过 1000 个周期，所使用的可用训练数据比例也微乎其微。

paragraphs.en: We use 200 200 dynamic importance sampling trajectories of adenylate kinase (AdK) [ Perilla et al., 2011 , Beckstein et al., 2009 ] , comprising 19,691 19{,}691 frames sampled at 1 ​ ps 1\,\mathrm{ps} intervals and split by trajectory into 160 / 20 / 20 160/20/20 training, validation, and test trajectories. AdK consists of a relatively stable CORE and the mobile LID and NMP domains, whose relative motion characterises the open–closed transition [ Beckstein et al., 2009 ] . We freeze the pretrained SLAE encoder Φ \Phi and decoder Ψ \Psi [ Chen et al., 2025 ] . SLAE represents each residue by an embedding of its local all-atom environment and decodes the resulting embeddings back to molecular coordinates. The encoder gives Y t = Φ ⁡ ( X t ) ∈ ℝ 214 × 128 Y_{t}=\Phi(X_{t})\in\mathbb{R}^{214\times 128} , or D = 27,392 D=27{,}392 latent coordinates, which we standardise using training-set statistics before fitting the transition models.

paragraphs.en: The mean and CDC networks preserve the 214 × 128 214\times 128 residue structure through residue-shared projections, learned positional embeddings, and residual blocks combining LayerNorm, four-head self-attention, and FiLM-conditioned MLPs with a sinusoidal embedding of τ \tau . The mean network uses width 128 128 and three residual blocks; the CDC network uses width 256 256 and four. We first fit the conditional mean m τ ϕ ​ ( Y t ) ≈ 𝔼 ⁡ [ Y t + τ ∣ Y t ] m_{\tau}^{\phi}(Y_{t})\approx\mathbb{E}[Y_{t+\tau}\mid Y_{t}] with Adam at learning rate 2 × 10 − 4 2\times 10^{-4} , batch size 64 64 , 200 200 batches per epoch, zero weight decay, and gradient clipping at norm 1 1 , for at most 400 400 epochs with patience 20 20 on validation displacement. We then freeze m ϕ m^{\phi} and train CDCs of rank r ∈ { 16 , 32 , 64 , 128 , 256 , 512 } r\in\{16,32,64,128,256,512\} on the centred residuals Y t + τ − m τ ϕ ​ ( Y t ) Y_{t+\tau}-m_{\tau}^{\phi}(Y_{t}) . This two-stage procedure has the same population optimum as joint Gaussian regression, while allowing the mean to be fitted once and shared across the rank sweep. The CDCs use IGM with low-rank parametrisation G τ θ = M τ θ ​ ( M τ θ ) ⊤ + ϵ θ ​ I G_{\tau}^{\theta}=M_{\tau}^{\theta}(M_{\tau}^{\theta})^{\top}+\epsilon^{\theta}I .
